description: Build a self-contained levels.html rendering four named tile-based canvas levels with arrow-key switching in a C64 style.

criteria: levels.html is one self-contained file with four named tile-map levels (Boot Valley, Crystal Cache, Frozen Stack, Lava Kernel), each a string array of equal-length rows with long open '.' runs near the top and solid '#' lower down, drawn to a canvas as pixel blocks, with Left/Right arrow keys switching levels and the current level name shown. The repetitive tile data is fully present (the stream was not truncated mid-array).
